tp: This anti-inflammatory role of cortisol is why glucocorticoid drugs are used for inflamed joints, asthma and itchy rashes.

ww.Immune system boosted, more inflammation: Cortisol suppresses immunity rather than boosting it.
ww.Selective destruction of B cells: The source describes general downregulation of the immune system, not destruction of B cells.

evidence: These drugs reflect another role of cortisol—the downregulation of the immune system, which inhibits the inflammatory response.
